title: Where labhq looks for sessions
lead: Only these folders are searched. A session whose working folder is outside them is not listed, summarised or analysed, and its conversation is never opened. Projects inside them are found by looking at folder names only: no file is read.
load_failed: The scan folders could not be loaded.
machine_wide: No folder is set, so the scan covers the whole machine. Add the folder that holds your projects to narrow it.
looking_in: Looking in {count} folder | Looking in {count} folders
passkey_note: Adding or removing a folder changes what labhq reads on this machine, so it asks for your passkey.
left_out: no sessions left out | 1 session left out | {count} sessions left out
capped: The search stopped after {count} folders, so some projects may be missing. Narrow the folders to see them all.
found_lead: Projects inside the folders above that have no session and are not in labhq yet.

errors.refused: Your passkey was not accepted. Nothing changed.
errors.invalid: That folder cannot be used. Nothing changed.
errors.failed: That did not work. Try again.
errors.network: labhq could not be reached. Try again.
